messages:
m1 | BBABB | 3 | Option 3 accurately renders the calendar hold, "stay past noon," and "two mornings," whereas Option 1 leaves "Subject:" in English and Options 1, 4, and 5 mistranslate the hold as "보류" (postponement).
m2 | AABAA | 2,5 | Option 3 introduces "my statement" despite the team sender ("회계팀"), while Options 2 and 5 most naturally render the receipt of two text messages and the statement discrepancy.
m3 | AAAAA | 1,3,4 | All options are sendable, with Options 1, 3, and 4 best preserving both "physical quantity" ("실물 수량") and present-tense inclusion in today's arrivals.
m4 | CCBBC | 4 | Option 5 is missing, Options 1 and 3 mistranslate "has not opened" as "접수하지 않았습니다" (not received/accepted), and Option 2 uses unnatural "개시하지" while transliterating source names.
m5 | CABBB | 2 | Option 1 is missing, Options 4 and 5 mistranslate "the trial" as "시범 절차" (trial procedure) with awkward loanwords, and Option 3 alters source names, leaving Option 2 sendable unchanged.
m6 | BAAAB | 3,5 | Option 4 leaves raw Markdown asterisks in the subject line and, like Option 1, uses bare "a receipt" for "접수증" instead of an acknowledgment or intake receipt.
m7 | ABCBA | 1,5 | Option 3 mistranslates the physical workshop as "워크숍" (seminar) and "on loan" as "임대 중" (leasing out), while Options 2 and 4 use commercial lease terms ("임대/임차") instead of "대여."
m8 | ABBAA | 1,4,5 | Options 2 and 3 leave raw Markdown asterisks in the subject line, whereas Options 1, 4, and 5 are clean, accurate, and immediately sendable.

m1 | BAAAA | 5 | Option 1 leaves Subject untranslated and uses awkward "체류"; Option 5 best translates calendar hold and workshop sessions ("오전 두 회차").
m2 | AAAAA | 2, 5 | Options 2 and 5 use natural active phrasing ("I received two approval text messages") rather than literal or passive constructions.
m3 | AAAAA | 1 | Option 1 accurately translates "실물 수량" as "physical quantity" and uses standard logistics phrasing ("today's delivery").
m4 | BBBAC | 4 | Option 5 is incomplete; Option 4 correctly translates "opened" as "착수하지 않았습니다" while 1-3 use inaccurate calques ("접수", "개시").
m5 | CAABB | 2, 3 | Option 1 is incomplete; Options 2 and 3 naturally translate "crew" and "trial", whereas 4 and 5 use awkward calques like "크루" and "초안 체크리스트".
m6 | AAABA | 3 | Option 4 has markdown formatting artifacts; Option 3 uses the most precise terminology ("acknowledgment of receipt") and proper request tone.
m7 | ABCAA | 1 | Option 3 mistranslates workshop as seminar ("워크숍"); Option 1 correctly and unambiguously states the pump is on loan from the supplier.
m8 | ABBAA | 4 | Options 2 and 3 contain markdown formatting artifacts; Option 4 uses idiomatic terminology ("reconciled the quantities") and clean formatting.

m1 | BAAAA | 3 | Option 1 leaves "Subject:" in English, and option 3 gives the most natural rendering of "hold, not booking"
m2 | BBBBB | 2 | Every option leaves the sign-off "회계팀" untranslated instead of "Accounting Team"
m3 | AAAAA | 1 | All are accurate, and option 1 most faithfully renders "reserved, not physical quantity" and "today's delivery"
m4 | CBCAC | 4 | Options 1 and 3 render "has not opened" as "접수하지 않았습니다" (not received), option 2 uses the unnatural "개시", and option 5 has no translation
m5 | CAABB | 2,3 | Option 1 has no translation, and options 4 and 5 make "the trial" into "시범 절차" (a trial procedure)
m6 | BBBBB | 3 | Every option leaves the sign-off "운영팀" untranslated, option 4 adds markdown and option 2 says "receipt acknowledgment"
m7 | ABBAB | 1,4 | Options 2 and 3 use "임대" (leasing out) and option 5 uses "대여 중" (lent out), so it is unclear the workshop borrowed the pump, and option 3 also uses "워크숍" for the shop
m8 | BBBBB | 1,4 | Every option translates "납품 명세서" as "specification" instead of delivery note/statement, and options 2 and 3 add markdown

m1 | BAABB | 3 | 2 and 3 clearly say June 3 is set aside. 보류 can suggest postponement.
m2 | BBBBB | 2,5 | All leave 회계팀 untranslated. 3 also adds “my” to the statement.
m3 | AAAAA | 3,4 | 3 and 4 explicitly distinguish the reserved quantity from the physical count and cover all of today’s arrivals.
m4 | CCCBC | 4 | “Unopened” becomes unregistered in 1 and 3, uninitiated in 2, and unstarted in 4. 5 is missing.
m5 | CAABB | 2,3 | 1 is missing. 4 and 5 change the agenda item from a trial run to a trial procedure.
m6 | CBCBC | 4 | Only 2 and 4 clearly direct the receiving staff member to issue the receipt. All leave 운영팀 untranslated.
m7 | ACCBA | 1,5 | 2 and 3 suggest renting the pump out. 3 also misidentifies the worksite, and 4 implies paid hire.
m8 | CCCCC | 1,4 | All five call the itemized delivery note a specification.
